title: Principal localization of the raw cohomology presheaf
statement: Let f : X → T be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], I an injective resolution of F, q a natural number, W an affine open of T, and a ∈ Γ(T,W). Put K = f_*I and P = sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], the presheaf V ↦ H^q(I(f⁻¹V)). Regard P(D(a)) as a Γ(T,W)-module by restriction of scalars along Γ(T,W) → Γ(T,D(a)). Then the canonical restriction P(W) → P(D(a)) is a module localization at the powers of a (IsLocalizedModule.Away).

source.place: Lemma 30.17.3, tensor-unit specialization; Tag 01E4, evaluation of the pushed-forward injective resolution.

proof.text: For N=P(D(a)) with scalars restricted along Γ(T,W)→Γ(T,D(a)), multiplication by a is bijective: its restriction is a unit by RingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen. Map this unit to Module.End over Γ(T,D(a)); Module.End.isUnit_iff identifies its bijective underlying map with the scalar action over Γ(T,W).

Apply IsLocalizedModule.Away.mk_of_addCommGroup. Fraction surjectivity comes from sectionCohomologyPresheaf_clearDenominators, rewriting restriction of a^n using map_pow. The kernel field comes from sectionCohomologyPresheaf_kernel_pow_annihilates. Mathlib subtracts equal numerators to obtain the general equality field.

proof_origin.place: Separate fraction-surjectivity and zero-kernel consequences of the tensor-unit comparison; combine by Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.Away.mk_of_addCommGroup.

mathlib_searches.query: cohomology of quasi coherent sheaves on principal open localizes and sheafification preserves affine values
Sections on a principal open are fractions of global sections for quasi coherent higher direct images
mathlib_searches.results: Generic tilde and localization constructions; no theorem for raw cohomology or affine values of a general presheaf sheafification. Existing invertS_cohomology and higherDirectImagePresheaf interfaces read separately.

mathlib_searches.query: IsLocalizedModule; sheafification unit; basis in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules, Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf and Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves
mathlib_searches.results: Tilde.toOpen localization; IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj; isIso_toSheafify for already sheaf presheaves; basis extension tools. No matching raw cohomology localization or affine-unit assertion for a presheaf satisfying localizations. Repository and DAG searched for duplicates.

mathlib_searches.query: IsLocalizedModule.Away; sheafification agrees with a presheaf on a gluing basis; module_sheafification_iso_of_affine_restriction
mathlib_searches.results: Loogle finds Away and local algebra criteria; LeanFinder finds sheaf hom ext, cover-dense amalgamation and sheafification constructions. Read Mathlib tilde.toOpen localization, existing invertS_cohomology, higherDirectImagePresheaf, basis extension, and module_sheafification_iso_of_affine_restriction. The latter assumes a supplied affine-basis identification with a sheaf and does not establish the localization-to-canonical-unit bridge. No direct duplicate found.

from.place: Denominator proof: raw cohomology localization and passage from the principal-open basis to actual higher-image sections.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomologyPresheaf_isLocalized_away {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let : Module Γ(T, W) (P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a))) :=
      Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
    IsLocalizedModule.Away a (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
